event: Identify the location of a ticking sound (gas stove burner) relative to a robot standing by the sink and facing the TV by the fireplace.

sounding_object.description: A stainless steel gas cooktop with multiple burners (the one being lit makes the ticking sound). It has black grates and is built into a white countertop with wooden cabinetry beneath and a stainless steel range hood above. Part of a larger kitchen stove unit.

reference_object.description: A white porcelain farmhouse-style sink with a silver faucet, located on a kitchen island/peninsula with a white countertop. This is where the kettle is filled.

facing_object.description: A dark, flat-screen TV mounted above a stone-faced fireplace. The fireplace has a wooden mantelpiece. Located in the living room area.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the sink with a tap and facing the tv by the fireplace, when the ticking sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
